text:
**Share your love with the world!**

Hello everyone 👋 AIC’s social team is working on a series highlighting love stories about couples from our community – and we would love to feature you! It’s a great opportunity to share your unique love story, and show the world that love always wins.

**What do we need to do?**

Not much! If you want us to feature you, we would need:
* A short text (no more than 300 words) about how you met, your experiences with the gradual process, the support you received from the AIC community, special things you want to share, etc.
* A few photos of you
* Your social media handles

That’s it – we’ll take care of the rest!

If you want to take part, DM me or comment on this post.

Looking forward to hearing all your amazing love stories 🥰
